# FPSOT signed records and transparency log specification

> How a public body seals the records that it issues and keeps them verifiable: ETSI seals in the formats of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/248 at level B-LT, RFC 3161 time stamps, a C2SP transparency log of salted hashes with yearly shards and an independent mirror, witnesses under a published tlog-policy, offline tlog-proof bundles for readers, monitoring, RFC 4998 evidence records for long-term preservation, retention and transfer, and algorithm agility toward post-quantum seals.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): roles, profiles, legal status, conformance and cited versions; LOG-001 to LOG-005.
- [Seals and signatures](spec/en/seals.adoc): LOG-010 to LOG-019.
- [Time stamps](spec/en/time-stamps.adoc): LOG-020 to LOG-024.
- [Transparency log](spec/en/transparency-log.adoc): LOG-030 to LOG-038.
- [Witnesses and policy](spec/en/witnesses.adoc): LOG-040 to LOG-046.
- [Proofs and verification](spec/en/proofs.adoc): LOG-050 to LOG-057.
- [Monitoring and incident response](spec/en/monitoring.adoc): LOG-060 to LOG-064.
- [Long-term preservation](spec/en/preservation.adoc): LOG-070 to LOG-075.
- [Retention, redaction and transfer](spec/en/retention.adoc): LOG-080 to LOG-085.
- [Algorithm agility and post-quantum](spec/en/post-quantum.adoc): LOG-090 to LOG-093.
- [Reference stack](spec/en/reference-stack.adoc): informative.
- [Questions for counsel](spec/en/questions-for-counsel.adoc): informative, not legal advice.
